toggle_12mm.description: Full size bat handle toggle, 15/32-32 NS threaded bushing (12 mm class)
toggle_12mm.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical values for the 15/32 in bushing class, not taken from a real part. Replace with calipers on the toggles you mount.

toggle_6mm.description: Miniature bat handle toggle, 1/4-40 UNS threaded bushing (6 mm class)
toggle_6mm.source: PLACEHOLDER: typical datasheet values for a miniature toggle with a 1/4-40 bushing 8.9 mm (0.35 in) long, in the style of the C&K 7000 series, not taken from a real part. max_panel_t is the bushing less two nuts and a lock washer; keepout_d is judgement, room for a fingertip and the 5/16 in nut wrench. Replace with calipers on the toggles you mount.

esp32_devboard.description: ESP32-H2 board (Zigbee, no wifi) with an onboard PCB antenna at one end and a USB connector at the other
esp32_devboard.source: PLACEHOLDER: envelope of a generic ESP32 dev board, not a chosen part. The radio decision needs an ESP32-H2. Antenna keepout is a rule of thumb for PCB antennas; check the module datasheet. Replace with the board you use.

battery_2aa_holder.description: Two AA cells end to end in the printed inline holder, screwed to the cavity floor
battery_2aa_holder.source: Envelope of cad/holders/battery_2aa_holder.scad (regen_all.py checks it). Cells per IEC 60086 LR6 maximum, 14.5 x 50.5. contact_space in the model is a placeholder until the bought contacts are measured.
